baseline._note: A_old/B/sigma are the original least-squares fit (basis I_RATED_old=1000A). A is that fit rescaled to the new current basis (I_RATED=1780A, I_NOMINAL_TRAFO) via A = A_old * (I_RATED/I_RATED_old)^2. B and sigma are additive/scale offsets independent of the current-normalization basis, so they are kept unchanged per the agreed design (not re-fit). TODO(kalibrasi): this is a basis conversion of the old fit, NOT a fresh calibration from real trafo 2/3/4 data — baseline_calibrated stays false until fit_baseline() is run on real history and the result is reviewed and written here manually.

thermal_lag._note: First-order lag filter on I^2 per phase: I2_eff[k] = phi*I2_eff[k-1] + (1-phi)*I_phase[k]^2, phi = exp(-dt/tau_minutes). tau_minutes is an engineering assumption, not fit from data.
thermal_lag._max_gap_note: TODO(kalibrasi): not specified in the task brief; chosen as 3 * tau_minutes as a reasonable default so the lag filter resets after a data gap longer than ~3 time constants instead of carrying a stale estimate forward indefinitely. Safe to change here.

residual_score._note: S_RES = clamp((max_phase_z - z_floor) / (z_full - z_floor) * score_max, 0, score_max). z = (deltaT_real - deltaT_pred) / sigma per phase.

component_refs._note: ref_temp_rise/ref_phase_delta are internal reference values for the exponential (Montsinger/Arrhenius-inspired heuristic) scoring curve, not a direct citation of an IEC limit. Compare separately against IEC 62271-1 contact-material temperature-rise tables if needed.
